description: This source file defines the NumberHelperService class, providing utility methods for formatting numbers, such as number formatting with specified decimals and grouping options within the OrangeHRM project.

classes.name: NumberHelperService
classes.description: A service class that offers methods to format numbers, including formatting with specified decimal places and grouping with thousands separators.

methods.name: numberFormat
methods.description: Formats a number with a specified number of decimals, using a dot as the decimal point and no thousands separator.

methods.name: numberFormatWithGroupedThousands
methods.description: Formats a number with specified decimals and an optional thousands separator, defaulting to a comma.
